tool_schemas.name: get_workspace_hierarchy
tool_schemas.description: Returns the workspace hierarchy snapshot (workspace → spaces → folders → lists) for the specified workspace, resolved by workspaceId or by workspaceName when workspaceId is not provided; if refresh is true we refresh our cached snapshot first, and includeArchived controls whether archived nodes are included in the tree. This endpoint is not paged and returns the full hierarchy we have for that workspace. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither workspaceId nor workspaceName is provided or an id fails the cu_wsp_… format, NOT_FOUND if the workspace cannot be resolved, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access that workspace.

workspaceId.description: Local workspace id (cu_wsp_...) to scope the hierarchy lookup.

workspaceName.description: Workspace name to resolve and return its hierarchy when workspaceId is not provided.

includeArchived.description: Whether to include archived spaces/folders/lists in the returned hierarchy.

refresh.description: If true, refresh the local hierarchy snapshot/cache before returning results.

tool_schemas.name: create_task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a single task in the destination list (resolved by listId or by listName within workspaceId) and returns the created task record with its local task id (cu_tsk_…) and resolved ClickUp identifiers. This endpoint is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is missing, if neither listId nor listName is provided, if an id format is invalid, or if provided fields are not valid for the destination list (for example an unknown status), NOT_FOUND if the target workspace/list cannot be resolved, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to create tasks in that list.

workspaceId.description: Local workspace id (cu_wsp_...) used to scope name-based resolution.

listId.description: Local list node id (cu_nod_...) to create the task in (preferred).

listName.description: List name to resolve within the workspace hierarchy when listId is not provided.

status.description: Status value to set on the task (must be valid for the destination list).

priority.description: Task priority as an integer (ClickUp-style numeric priority).

assigneeClickupUserIds.description: Array of ClickUp user ids to assign to the task.

tags.description: Array of tag names to apply to the task.

timeEstimateMs.description: Time estimate for the task in milliseconds.

tool_schemas.name: get_task
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns a single task with full detail, resolved by taskId (preferred) or by taskName (optionally disambiguated with listName) within the scoped workspaceId when resolving by name. This endpoint is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither taskId nor taskName is provided or an id format is invalid, NOT_FOUND if no matching task is found, CONFLICT if taskName resolution matches multiple tasks and listName is not sufficient to disambiguate, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the task.

workspaceId.description: Local workspace id (cu_wsp_...) used to scope name-based resolution.

taskName.description: Task name to resolve when taskId is not provided.

listName.description: Optional list name to disambiguate when resolving by taskName.

tool_schemas.name: get_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Lists tasks in a list resolved by listId (preferred) or listName and returns a page of results filtered and sorted by the provided criteria; pagination uses limit (1–200) and an opaque cursor, and the response includes the next cursor when more results are available. Filters include status, date ranges (due/start/created/updated), assigneeClickupUserIds, tags, and archived when supported. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither listId nor listName is provided, if an id format is invalid, if limit is out of range, or if date filters are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the list cannot be resolved, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot view tasks in that list.

workspaceId.description: Local workspace id (cu_wsp_...) used to scope name-based resolution.

listId.description: Local list node id (cu_nod_...) to fetch tasks from (preferred).

listName.description: List name to resolve within the workspace hierarchy when listId is not provided.

status.description: Filter tasks by one or more status values.

dueAfter.description: Filter to tasks with due date/time after this timestamp.

dueBefore.description: Filter to tasks with due date/time before this timestamp.

startAfter.description: Filter to tasks with start date/time after this timestamp.

startBefore.description: Filter to tasks with start date/time before this timestamp.

createdAfter.description: Filter to tasks created after this timestamp.

createdBefore.description: Filter to tasks created before this timestamp.

updatedAfter.description: Filter to tasks updated after this timestamp.

updatedBefore.description: Filter to tasks updated before this timestamp.

assigneeClickupUserIds.description: Filter to tasks assigned to any of the specified ClickUp user ids.

tags.description: Filter to tasks that have any of the specified tag names.

archived.description: Whether to include archived tasks (if supported by the backend).

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: update_task
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing task resolved by taskId (preferred) or by taskName (optionally disambiguated with listName) and returns the updated task record. This endpoint is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither taskId nor taskName is provided, if no updatable fields are provided, if an id format is invalid, or if a requested update is not valid for the task’s list (for example an unknown status), NOT_FOUND if the task cannot be resolved, CONFLICT if name-based resolution matches multiple tasks, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot edit the task.

workspaceId.description: Local workspace id (cu_wsp_...) used to scope name-based resolution.

taskName.description: Task name to resolve when taskId is not provided.

listName.description: Optional list name to disambiguate when resolving by taskName.

status.description: New status value (must be valid for the task's list).

priority.description: New priority as an integer (ClickUp-style numeric priority).

dueAt.description: New due date/time for the task.

startAt.description: New start date/time for the task.

assigneeClickupUserIds.description: Replace task assignees with this array of ClickUp user ids.

tags.description: Replace task tags with this array of tag names.

tool_schemas.name: move_task
tool_schemas.description: Move a task to a different list. Valid parameter combinations: 1. Use taskId + (listId or listName) - preferred 2. Use taskName + sourceListName + (listId or listName) WARNING: Task statuses may reset if destination list has different status options.

workspaceId.description: Local workspace id (cu_wsp_...) used to scope name-based resolution.

taskName.description: Task name to resolve when taskId is not provided.

sourceListName.description: Source list name required when resolving a task by taskName for moving.

listId.description: Destination local list node id (cu_nod_...) (preferred destination identifier).

listName.description: Destination list name to resolve when listId is not provided.

tool_schemas.name: duplicate_task
tool_schemas.description: Create a copy of a task in the same or different list. Valid parameter combinations: 1. Use taskId + optional (listId or listName) - preferred 2. Use taskName + sourceListName + optional (listId or listName) The duplicate preserves the original task's properties.

workspaceId.description: Local workspace id (cu_wsp_...) used to scope name-based resolution.

taskName.description: Task name to resolve when taskId is not provided.

sourceListName.description: Source list name required when resolving a task by taskName for duplication.

listId.description: Optional destination local list node id (cu_nod_...); if omitted duplicates into the source list.

listName.description: Optional destination list name; if omitted duplicates into the source list.

tool_schemas.name: delete_task
tool_schemas.description: ⚠️ PERMANENTLY DELETE a task. This action cannot be undone. Valid parameter combinations: 1. Use taskId alone (preferred and safest) 2. Use taskName + optional listName (use with caution)

workspaceId.description: Local workspace id (cu_wsp_...) used to scope name-based resolution.

taskId.description: Local task id (cu_tsk_...) to permanently delete (preferred).

taskName.description: Task name to resolve when taskId is not provided (use with caution).

listName.description: Optional list name to disambiguate when resolving by taskName.

tool_schemas.name: create_bulk_tasks
tool_schemas.description:
Create multiple tasks in a list efficiently. You MUST provide:
1. An array of tasks with required properties
2. Either listId or listName to specify the target list

Optional: Configure batch size and concurrency for performance.

listId.description: Local list node id (nodes.id) identifying the target list.

listName.description: List name to resolve the target list (less reliable than listId).

tasks.description: Array of task definitions to create in the target list.

status.description: Status value to set on the task in the target list.

assigneeClickupUserIds.description: Array of ClickUp user ids to assign to the task.

tags.description: Array of tag strings to apply to the task.

batchSize.description: Number of tasks per batch when executing the bulk job.

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent worker operations for the bulk job.

tool_schemas.name: update_bulk_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Update multiple tasks efficiently. For each task, you MUST provide either: 1. taskId alone (preferred) 2. taskName + listName Only specified fields will be updated for each task.

tasks.description: Array of task updates; each item must identify the task and include only fields to change.

taskId.description: Local task id (tasks.id) to update (preferred identifier).

taskName.description: Task name to resolve within a list when taskId is not provided.

listName.description: List name used to scope taskName resolution when taskId is not provided.

status.description: New status value for the task.

assigneeClickupUserIds.description: New assignee ClickUp user ids to set on the task.

tags.description: New tags array to set on the task.

batchSize.description: Number of tasks per batch when executing the bulk job.

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent worker operations for the bulk job.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def update_bulk_tasks(tasks, batchSize=None, concurrency=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, uuid
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0438000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0438000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    op_log = _load("operation_log.json")
    bulk_jobs = _load("bulk_jobs.json")
    workspaces = _load("workspaces.json")
    nodes = _load("nodes.json")
    tasks_store = _load("tasks.json")

    def _log(status, workspace_id=None, bulk_job_id=None, warnings=None, resolution_trace=None, http_status=None, clickup_request=None, clickup_response=None, request_params=None):
        entry = {
            "id": "op_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper(),
            "workspace_id": workspace_id,
            "tool_name": "update_bulk_tasks",
            "bulk_job_id": bulk_job_id,
            "request_params": request_params if request_params is not None else {"tasks": tasks, "batchSize": batchSize, "concurrency": concurrency},
            "resolution_trace": resolution_trace,
            "clickup_request": clickup_request,
            "clickup_response": clickup_response,
            "http_status": http_status,
            "warnings": warnings,
            "status": status,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        op_log.append(entry)
        _save("operation_log.json", op_log)

    if not isinstance(tasks, list):
        _log("error")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "tasks must be an array")
    if len(tasks) < 1:
        _log("error")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "tasks must contain at least 1 item")

    if batchSize is not None:
        if not isinstance(batchSize, int):
            _log("error")
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "batchSize must be an integer")
        if batchSize < 1 or batchSize > 500:
            _log("error")
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "batchSize must be between 1 and 500")
    if concurrency is not None:
        if not isinstance(concurrency, int):
            _log("error")
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "concurrency must be an integer")
        if concurrency < 1 or concurrency > 50:
            _log("error")
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "concurrency must be between 1 and 50")

    # Create bulk job
    bulk_job_id = "cu_bj_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()
    job = {
        "id": bulk_job_id,
        "workspace_id": None,  # determined per item; set if all same
        "job_type": "update_bulk_tasks",
        "target_list_node_id": None,
        "batch_size": batchSize,
        "concurrency": concurrency,
        "input_items": tasks,
        "result_summary": None,
        "status": "queued",
        "started_at": None,
        "finished_at": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    bulk_jobs.append(job)
    _save("bulk_jobs.json", bulk_jobs)

    job["status"] = "running"
    job["started_at"] = now
    job["updated_at"] = now
    _save("bulk_jobs.json", bulk_jobs)

    ws_by_id = {w.get("id"): w for w in workspaces}
    nodes_by_name = {}
    for n in nodes:
        if n.get("status") == "deleted" or n.get("node_type") != "list":
            continue
        nodes_by_name.setdefault(n.get("name"), []).append(n)

    tasks_by_id = {t.get("id"): t for t in tasks_store}

    # Idempotency: if an item references a taskId already processed successfully for this bulk job, don't apply twice.
    done_task_ids = set()
    for o in op_log:
        if o.get("bulk_job_id") == bulk_job_id and o.get("tool_name") == "update_bulk_tasks" and o.get("status") == "success":
            rt = o.get("resolution_trace") or {}
            tid = rt.get("taskId")
            if isinstance(tid, str):
                done_task_ids.add(tid)

    succeeded = 0
    failed = 0
    errors_by_type = {}
    per_item = []
    common_workspace = None
    common_workspace_set = True

    allowed_update_fields = {"name", "description", "status", "priority", "dueAt", "startAt", "assigneeClickupUserIds", "tags", "timeEstimateMs"}
    ident_fields = {"taskId", "taskName", "listName"}

    def _resolve_list_by_name_scoped(list_name):
        # scope-aware within a workspace: here no workspace param exists, so ambiguity across workspaces must error
        cands = [n for n in nodes_by_name.get(list_name, []) if ws_by_id.get(n.get("workspace_id"), {}).get("status") in ("active", "archived")]
        by_ws = {}
        for n in cands:
            by_ws.setdefault(n.get("workspace_id"), []).append(n)
        # must be exactly one overall after considering workspaces
        if len(cands) == 0:
            return None, {"listName": list_name, "matches": []}, "NOT_FOUND"
        if len(by_ws) > 1:
            return None, {"listName": list_name, "matches_by_workspace": {k: [x.get("id") for x in v] for k, v in by_ws.items()}}, "CONFLICT"
        if len(cands) > 1:
            return None, {"listName": list_name, "matches": [x.get("id") for x in cands]}, "CONFLICT"
        return cands[0], {"listName": list_name, "listId": cands[0].get("id"), "workspaceId": cands[0].get("workspace_id")}, None

    for idx, it in enumerate(tasks):
        item_params = {"tasks": [it], "batchSize": batchSize, "concurrency": concurrency}
        if not isinstance(it, dict):
            failed += 1
            errors_by_type["VALIDATION_ERROR"] = errors_by_type.get("VALIDATION_ERROR", 0) + 1
            per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": "task item must be an object"}})
            _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace={"item_index": idx}, http_status=400, clickup_response={"error": "task item must be an object"}, request_params=item_params)
            continue

        extra = set(it.keys()) - (allowed_update_fields | ident_fields)
        if extra:
            failed += 1
            errors_by_type["VALIDATION_ERROR"] = errors_by_type.get("VALIDATION_ERROR", 0) + 1
            msg = f"tasks[{idx}] has unexpected fields: {sorted(list(extra))}"
            per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": msg}})
            _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace={"item_index": idx}, http_status=400, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
            continue

        # Must include identifier: taskId OR (taskName+listName)
        taskId = it.get("taskId")
        taskName = it.get("taskName")
        listName = it.get("listName")
        if taskId is None and not (isinstance(taskName, str) and taskName.strip() and isinstance(listName, str) and listName.strip()):
            failed += 1
            errors_by_type["VALIDATION_ERROR"] = errors_by_type.get("VALIDATION_ERROR", 0) + 1
            msg = "Each item must include taskId or (taskName and listName)"
            per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": msg}})
            _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace={"item_index": idx}, http_status=400, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
            continue

        if taskId is not None:
            if not isinstance(taskId, str) or not re.match(r"^cu_tsk_[0-9A-Z]+$", taskId):
                failed += 1
                errors_by_type["VALIDATION_ERROR"] = errors_by_type.get("VALIDATION_ERROR", 0) + 1
                msg = "taskId must match pattern ^cu_tsk_[0-9A-Z]+$"
                per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": msg}})
                _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace={"item_index": idx}, http_status=400, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
                continue

        # Validate update fields types/constraints
        if "priority" in it and it["priority"] is not None:
            if not isinstance(it["priority"], int) or it["priority"] < 1 or it["priority"] > 4:
                failed += 1
                errors_by_type["VALIDATION_ERROR"] = errors_by_type.get("VALIDATION_ERROR", 0) + 1
                msg = "priority must be an integer between 1 and 4"
                per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": msg}})
                _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace={"item_index": idx}, http_status=400, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
                continue
        if "timeEstimateMs" in it and it["timeEstimateMs"] is not None:
            if not isinstance(it["timeEstimateMs"], int) or it["timeEstimateMs"] < 0:
                failed += 1
                errors_by_type["VALIDATION_ERROR"] = errors_by_type.get("VALIDATION_ERROR", 0) + 1
                msg = "timeEstimateMs must be an integer >= 0"
                per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": msg}})
                _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace={"item_index": idx}, http_status=400, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
                continue
        for fld in ("dueAt", "startAt"):
            if fld in it and it[fld] is not None:
                if not isinstance(it[fld], str):
                    failed += 1
                    errors_by_type["VALIDATION_ERROR"] = errors_by_type.get("VALIDATION_ERROR", 0) + 1
                    msg = f"{fld} must be a date-time string"
                    per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": msg}})
                    _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace={"item_index": idx}, http_status=400, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
                    continue
                try:
                    s = it[fld].replace("Z", "+00:00") if it[fld].endswith("Z") else it[fld]
                    datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
                except Exception:
                    failed += 1
                    errors_by_type["VALIDATION_ERROR"] = errors_by_type.get("VALIDATION_ERROR", 0) + 1
                    msg = f"{fld} must be an ISO 8601 date-time string"
                    per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": msg}})
                    _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace={"item_index": idx}, http_status=400, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
                    continue

        if "assigneeClickupUserIds" in it and it["assigneeClickupUserIds"] is not None:
            if not isinstance(it["assigneeClickupUserIds"], list) or any(not isinstance(x, str) for x in it["assigneeClickupUserIds"]):
                failed += 1
                errors_by_type["VALIDATION_ERROR"] = errors_by_type.get("VALIDATION_ERROR", 0) + 1
                msg = "assigneeClickupUserIds must be an array of strings"
                per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": msg}})
                _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace={"item_index": idx}, http_status=400, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
                continue
        if "tags" in it and it["tags"] is not None:
            if not isinstance(it["tags"], list) or any(not isinstance(x, str) for x in it["tags"]):
                failed += 1
                errors_by_type["VALIDATION_ERROR"] = errors_by_type.get("VALIDATION_ERROR", 0) + 1
                msg = "tags must be an array of strings"
                per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": msg}})
                _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace={"item_index": idx}, http_status=400, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
                continue

        # Must have at least one update field
        update_keys = [k for k in allowed_update_fields if k in it]
        if len(update_keys) == 0:
            failed += 1
            errors_by_type["VALIDATION_ERROR"] = errors_by_type.get("VALIDATION_ERROR", 0) + 1
            msg = "No update fields provided for this item"
            per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": msg}})
            _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace={"item_index": idx}, http_status=400, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
            continue

        # Resolve task
        trace = {"item_index": idx}
        task_row = None
        if taskId is not None:
            if taskId in done_task_ids:
                per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "skipped", "reason": "already_processed", "taskId": taskId})
                continue
            task_row = tasks_by_id.get(taskId)
            trace["taskId"] = taskId
            if not task_row or task_row.get("status") == "deleted":
                failed += 1
                errors_by_type["NOT_FOUND"] = errors_by_type.get("NOT_FOUND", 0) + 1
                msg = "Task not found"
                per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "NOT_FOUND", "message": msg}, "taskId": taskId})
                _log("error", workspace_id=None, bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace=trace, http_status=404, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
                continue
        else:
            # resolve list first (required)
            lst, lst_trace, lst_err = _resolve_list_by_name_scoped(listName)
            trace["list_resolution"] = lst_trace
            if lst_err == "NOT_FOUND":
                failed += 1
                errors_by_type["NOT_FOUND"] = errors_by_type.get("NOT_FOUND", 0) + 1
                msg = "List not found for listName"
                per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "NOT_FOUND", "message": msg}, "listName": listName})
                _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace=trace, http_status=404, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
                continue
            if lst_err == "CONFLICT":
                failed += 1
                errors_by_type["CONFLICT"] = errors_by_type.get("CONFLICT", 0) + 1
                msg = "Ambiguous listName; provide taskId"
                per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "CONFLICT", "message": msg}, "listName": listName})
                _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace=trace, http_status=409, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
                continue

            # resolve taskName within list
            matches = [t for t in tasks_store if t.get("status") != "deleted" and t.get("list_node_id") == lst.get("id") and t.get("name") == taskName]
            trace["taskName"] = taskName
            if len(matches) == 0:
                failed += 1
                errors_by_type["NOT_FOUND"] = errors_by_type.get("NOT_FOUND", 0) + 1
                msg = "Task not found in list"
                per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "NOT_FOUND", "message": msg}, "taskName": taskName, "listName": listName})
                _log("error", workspace_id=lst.get("workspace_id"), bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace=trace, http_status=404, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
                continue
            if len(matches) > 1:
                failed += 1
                errors_by_type["CONFLICT"] = errors_by_type.get("CONFLICT", 0) + 1
                msg = "Ambiguous taskName within list; provide taskId"
                per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "CONFLICT", "message": msg}, "taskName": taskName, "listName": listName})
                _log("error", workspace_id=lst.get("workspace_id"), bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace=trace, http_status=409, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
                continue
            task_row = matches[0]
            trace["taskId"] = task_row.get("id")

        # Workspace tracking for job
        wid = task_row.get("workspace_id")
        if common_workspace is None:
            common_workspace = wid
        elif common_workspace != wid:
            common_workspace_set = False

        ws = ws_by_id.get(wid)
        if not ws or ws.get("status") == "deleted":
            failed += 1
            errors_by_type["UNAUTHORIZED"] = errors_by_type.get("UNAUTHORIZED", 0) + 1
            msg = "No accessible workspace found for this task"
            per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "UNAUTHORIZED", "message": msg}, "taskId": task_row.get("id")})
            _log("error", workspace_id=wid, bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace=trace, http_status=403, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
            continue

        # Apply updates (only provided fields)
        try:
            if "name" in it:
                if it["name"] is not None and (not isinstance(it["name"], str) or it["name"].strip() == ""):
                    raise ValueError("name must be a non-empty string")
                task_row["name"] = it["name"]
            if "description" in it:
                if it["description"] is not None and not isinstance(it["description"], str):
                    raise ValueError("description must be a string or null")
                task_row["description"] = it["description"]
            if "status" in it:
                if it["status"] is not None and not isinstance(it["status"], str):
                    raise ValueError("status must be a string or null")
                task_row["status_value"] = it["status"]
                if it["status"] is not None:
                    task_row["closed_at"] = None
            if "priority" in it:
                task_row["priority"] = it["priority"]
            if "dueAt" in it:
                task_row["due_at"] = it["dueAt"]
            if "startAt" in it:
                task_row["start_at"] = it["startAt"]
            if "assigneeClickupUserIds" in it:
                task_row["assignee_clickup_user_ids"] = it["assigneeClickupUserIds"]
            if "tags" in it:
                task_row["tags"] = it["tags"]
            if "timeEstimateMs" in it:
                task_row["time_estimate_ms"] = it["timeEstimateMs"]
            task_row["updated_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

            _save("tasks.json", tasks_store)

            succeeded += 1
            per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "success", "taskId": task_row.get("id")})
            _log("success", workspace_id=wid, bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace=trace, http_status=200, clickup_request={"method": "PUT", "endpoint": "/task/{task_id}", "body": {k: it.get(k) for k in update_keys}}, clickup_response={"ok": True}, request_params=item_params)
            done_task_ids.add(task_row.get("id"))
        except Exception as e:
            failed += 1
            errors_by_type["VALIDATION_ERROR"] = errors_by_type.get("VALIDATION_ERROR", 0) + 1
            per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": str(e)}, "taskId": task_row.get("id")})
            _log("error", workspace_id=wid, bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace=trace, http_status=400, clickup_response={"error": str(e)}, request_params=item_params)

    job["workspace_id"] = common_workspace if common_workspace_set else None
    job["result_summary"] = {
        "succeeded": succeeded,
        "failed": failed,
        "errors_by_type": errors_by_type,
        "items": per_item,
    }
    job["status"] = "completed" if failed == 0 else "failed"
    job["finished_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    job["updated_at"] = job["finished_at"]
    _save("bulk_jobs.json", bulk_jobs)

    latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    return {"bulkJob": job, "meta": {"latency_ms": latency_ms}}

tool_schemas.name: move_bulk_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Moves the specified tasks into a destination list identified by targetListId or resolved by targetListName, returning a bulk operation result with per-task successes/failures (tasks are processed in batches via batchSize with up to concurrency workers). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tasks is empty, any task item lacks either taskId or (taskName and listName), ids do not match required patterns, or batchSize/concurrency are < 1; raises NOT_FOUND if the destination list cannot be resolved or a referenced task/source list cannot be resolved. Raises CONFLICT when a task cannot be moved due to an invalid state transition or destination constraints (including status mismatches that require remapping), and FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to move tasks into/from the resolved lists or exceeds enforced bulk/worker limits.

targetListId.description: Local list node id (nodes.id) of the destination list.

targetListName.description: Destination list name to resolve the target list (less reliable than targetListId).

tasks.description: Array of tasks to move; each item must identify the task to move.

taskId.description: Local task id (tasks.id) to move (preferred identifier).

taskName.description: Task name to resolve within a list when taskId is not provided.

listName.description: Source list name used to scope taskName resolution when taskId is not provided.

batchSize.description: Number of tasks per batch when executing the bulk job.

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent worker operations for the bulk job.

tool_schemas.name: delete_bulk_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Permanently deletes the specified tasks and returns a bulk operation result with per-task successes/failures (tasks are processed in batches via batchSize with up to concurrency workers). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tasks is empty, any task item lacks either taskId or (taskName and listName), ids do not match required patterns, or batchSize/concurrency are < 1; raises NOT_FOUND if a referenced task or the list needed to resolve taskName cannot be found. Raises FORBIDDEN when the caller is not authorized to delete tasks from the resolved lists or exceeds enforced bulk/worker limits, and CONFLICT when a task cannot be deleted due to an invalid lifecycle/state (for example, already deleted in the cache lifecycle).

tasks.description: Array of tasks to permanently delete; each item must identify the task.

taskId.description: Local task id (tasks.id) to delete (preferred and safest identifier).

taskName.description: Task name to resolve within a list when taskId is not provided.

listName.description: List name used to scope taskName resolution when taskId is not provided.

batchSize.description: Number of tasks per batch when executing the bulk job.

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent worker operations for the bulk job.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def delete_bulk_tasks(tasks, batchSize=None, concurrency=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, uuid
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0438000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0438000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    op_log = _load("operation_log.json")
    bulk_jobs = _load("bulk_jobs.json")
    workspaces = _load("workspaces.json")
    nodes = _load("nodes.json")
    tasks_store = _load("tasks.json")

    def _log(status, workspace_id=None, bulk_job_id=None, warnings=None, resolution_trace=None, http_status=None, clickup_request=None, clickup_response=None, request_params=None):
        entry = {
            "id": "op_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper(),
            "workspace_id": workspace_id,
            "tool_name": "delete_bulk_tasks",
            "bulk_job_id": bulk_job_id,
            "request_params": request_params if request_params is not None else {"tasks": tasks, "batchSize": batchSize, "concurrency": concurrency},
            "resolution_trace": resolution_trace,
            "clickup_request": clickup_request,
            "clickup_response": clickup_response,
            "http_status": http_status,
            "warnings": warnings,
            "status": status,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        op_log.append(entry)
        _save("operation_log.json", op_log)

    if not isinstance(tasks, list):
        _log("error")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "tasks must be an array")
    if len(tasks) < 1:
        _log("error")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "tasks must contain at least 1 item")

    if batchSize is not None:
        if not isinstance(batchSize, int):
            _log("error")
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "batchSize must be an integer")
        if batchSize < 1 or batchSize > 500:
            _log("error")
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "batchSize must be between 1 and 500")
    if concurrency is not None:
        if not isinstance(concurrency, int):
            _log("error")
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "concurrency must be an integer")
        if concurrency < 1 or concurrency > 50:
            _log("error")
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "concurrency must be between 1 and 50")

    ws_by_id = {w.get("id"): w for w in workspaces}
    tasks_by_id = {t.get("id"): t for t in tasks_store}

    nodes_by_name = {}
    for n in nodes:
        if n.get("status") == "deleted" or n.get("node_type") != "list":
            continue
        nodes_by_name.setdefault(n.get("name"), []).append(n)

    def _resolve_list_by_name_scoped(list_name):
        cands = [n for n in nodes_by_name.get(list_name, []) if ws_by_id.get(n.get("workspace_id"), {}).get("status") in ("active", "archived")]
        by_ws = {}
        for n in cands:
            by_ws.setdefault(n.get("workspace_id"), []).append(n)
        if len(cands) == 0:
            return None, {"listName": list_name, "matches": []}, "NOT_FOUND"
        if len(by_ws) > 1:
            return None, {"listName": list_name, "matches_by_workspace": {k: [x.get("id") for x in v] for k, v in by_ws.items()}}, "CONFLICT"
        if len(cands) > 1:
            return None, {"listName": list_name, "matches": [x.get("id") for x in cands]}, "CONFLICT"
        return cands[0], {"listName": list_name, "listId": cands[0].get("id"), "workspaceId": cands[0].get("workspace_id")}, None

    # Create bulk job
    bulk_job_id = "cu_bj_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()
    job = {
        "id": bulk_job_id,
        "workspace_id": None,  # determined per item
        "job_type": "delete_bulk_tasks",
        "target_list_node_id": None,
        "batch_size": batchSize,
        "concurrency": concurrency,
        "input_items": tasks,
        "result_summary": None,
        "status": "queued",
        "started_at": None,
        "finished_at": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    bulk_jobs.append(job)
    _save("bulk_jobs.json", bulk_jobs)

    job["status"] = "running"
    job["started_at"] = now
    job["updated_at"] = now
    _save("bulk_jobs.json", bulk_jobs)

    # Idempotency: don't delete twice within same job
    done_task_ids = set()
    for o in op_log:
        if o.get("bulk_job_id") == bulk_job_id and o.get("tool_name") == "delete_bulk_tasks" and o.get("status") == "success":
            rt = o.get("resolution_trace") or {}
            tid = rt.get("taskId")
            if isinstance(tid, str):
                done_task_ids.add(tid)

    succeeded = 0
    failed = 0
    errors_by_type = {}
    per_item = []
    common_workspace = None
    common_workspace_set = True

    for idx, it in enumerate(tasks):
        item_params = {"tasks": [it], "batchSize": batchSize, "concurrency": concurrency}
        if not isinstance(it, dict):
            failed += 1
            errors_by_type["VALIDATION_ERROR"] = errors_by_type.get("VALIDATION_ERROR", 0) + 1
            msg = "task item must be an object"
            per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": msg}})
            _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace={"item_index": idx}, http_status=400, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
            continue

        extra = set(it.keys()) - {"taskId", "taskName", "listName"}
        if extra:
            failed += 1
            errors_by_type["VALIDATION_ERROR"] = errors_by_type.get("VALIDATION_ERROR", 0) + 1
            msg = f"tasks[{idx}] has unexpected fields: {sorted(list(extra))}"
            per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": msg}})
            _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace={"item_index": idx}, http_status=400, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
            continue

        taskId = it.get("taskId")
        taskName = it.get("taskName")
        listName = it.get("listName")
        if taskId is None and not (isinstance(taskName, str) and taskName.strip() and isinstance(listName, str) and listName.strip()):
            failed += 1
            errors_by_type["VALIDATION_ERROR"] = errors_by_type.get("VALIDATION_ERROR", 0) + 1
            msg = "Each item must include taskId or (taskName and listName)"
            per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": msg}})
            _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace={"item_index": idx}, http_status=400, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
            continue

        if taskId is not None:
            if not isinstance(taskId, str) or not re.match(r"^cu_tsk_[0-9A-Z]+$", taskId):
                failed += 1
                errors_by_type["VALIDATION_ERROR"] = errors_by_type.get("VALIDATION_ERROR", 0) + 1
                msg = "taskId must match pattern ^cu_tsk_[0-9A-Z]+$"
                per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": msg}})
                _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace={"item_index": idx}, http_status=400, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
                continue

        trace = {"item_index": idx}
        task_row = None
        if taskId is not None:
            if taskId in done_task_ids:
                per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "skipped", "reason": "already_processed", "taskId": taskId})
                continue
            task_row = tasks_by_id.get(taskId)
            trace["taskId"] = taskId
            if not task_row:
                failed += 1
                errors_by_type["NOT_FOUND"] = errors_by_type.get("NOT_FOUND", 0) + 1
                msg = "Task not found"
                per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "NOT_FOUND", "message": msg}, "taskId": taskId})
                _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace=trace, http_status=404, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
                continue
        else:
            lst, lst_trace, lst_err = _resolve_list_by_name_scoped(listName)
            trace["list_resolution"] = lst_trace
            if lst_err == "NOT_FOUND":
                failed += 1
                errors_by_type["NOT_FOUND"] = errors_by_type.get("NOT_FOUND", 0) + 1
                msg = "List not found for listName"
                per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "NOT_FOUND", "message": msg}, "listName": listName})
                _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace=trace, http_status=404, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
                continue
            if lst_err == "CONFLICT":
                failed += 1
                errors_by_type["CONFLICT"] = errors_by_type.get("CONFLICT", 0) + 1
                msg = "Ambiguous listName; provide taskId"
                per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "CONFLICT", "message": msg}, "listName": listName})
                _log("error", bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace=trace, http_status=409, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
                continue
            matches = [t for t in tasks_store if t.get("status") != "deleted" and t.get("list_node_id") == lst.get("id") and t.get("name") == taskName]
            trace["taskName"] = taskName
            if len(matches) == 0:
                failed += 1
                errors_by_type["NOT_FOUND"] = errors_by_type.get("NOT_FOUND", 0) + 1
                msg = "Task not found in list"
                per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "NOT_FOUND", "message": msg}, "taskName": taskName, "listName": listName})
                _log("error", workspace_id=lst.get("workspace_id"), bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace=trace, http_status=404, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
                continue
            if len(matches) > 1:
                failed += 1
                errors_by_type["CONFLICT"] = errors_by_type.get("CONFLICT", 0) + 1
                msg = "Ambiguous taskName within list; provide taskId"
                per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "CONFLICT", "message": msg}, "taskName": taskName, "listName": listName})
                _log("error", workspace_id=lst.get("workspace_id"), bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace=trace, http_status=409, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
                continue
            task_row = matches[0]
            trace["taskId"] = task_row.get("id")

        wid = task_row.get("workspace_id")
        if common_workspace is None:
            common_workspace = wid
        elif common_workspace != wid:
            common_workspace_set = False

        ws = ws_by_id.get(wid)
        if not ws or ws.get("status") == "deleted":
            failed += 1
            errors_by_type["UNAUTHORIZED"] = errors_by_type.get("UNAUTHORIZED", 0) + 1
            msg = "No accessible workspace found for this task"
            per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "error", "error": {"code": "UNAUTHORIZED", "message": msg}, "taskId": task_row.get("id")})
            _log("error", workspace_id=wid, bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace=trace, http_status=403, clickup_response={"error": msg}, request_params=item_params)
            continue

        # Permanent delete => status transition active->deleted only; idempotent if already deleted
        if task_row.get("status") == "deleted":
            # idempotent success, but still count as success
            succeeded += 1
            per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "success", "taskId": task_row.get("id"), "note": "already_deleted"})
            _log("success", workspace_id=wid, bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace=trace, http_status=200, clickup_response={"ok": True, "note": "already_deleted"}, request_params=item_params)
            done_task_ids.add(task_row.get("id"))
            continue

        # Apply delete
        task_row["status"] = "deleted"
        task_row["updated_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        _save("tasks.json", tasks_store)

        succeeded += 1
        per_item.append({"index": idx, "status": "success", "taskId": task_row.get("id")})
        _log("success", workspace_id=wid, bulk_job_id=bulk_job_id, resolution_trace=trace, http_status=200, clickup_request={"method": "DELETE", "endpoint": "/task/{task_id}"}, clickup_response={"ok": True}, request_params=item_params)
        done_task_ids.add(task_row.get("id"))

    job["workspace_id"] = common_workspace if common_workspace_set else None
    job["result_summary"] = {
        "succeeded": succeeded,
        "failed": failed,
        "errors_by_type": errors_by_type,
        "items": per_item,
    }
    job["status"] = "completed" if failed == 0 else "failed"
    job["finished_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    job["updated_at"] = job["finished_at"]
    _save("bulk_jobs.json", bulk_jobs)

    latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    return {"bulkJob": job, "meta": {"latency_ms": latency_ms}}

tool_schemas.name: create_list
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new list directly under a space (not inside a folder) and returns the created list record as cached locally, resolving the parent by spaceId or by spaceName. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is missing/empty, if neither spaceId nor spaceName is provided, or if provided ids do not match the required pattern/fields are otherwise invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the target space cannot be resolved, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to create lists in that space, and CONFLICT if a list cannot be created due to parent state (for example, creating under an archived/deleted parent as enforced by the server’s lifecycle rules).

spaceId.description: Local space node id (nodes.id) where the list will be created.

spaceName.description: Space name to resolve where the list will be created (less reliable than spaceId).

archived.description: Whether the list should be created as archived.

overrideStatuses.description: Whether the list should override space statuses.

tool_schemas.name: create_list_in_folder
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new list within a folder and returns the created list record as cached locally, resolving the folder by folderId or by folderName scoped by spaceId/spaceName. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is missing/empty, if folderId is not provided and folderName is missing, or if folderName is provided without spaceId/spaceName, or if provided ids do not match the required pattern/fields are otherwise invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the folder (or scoping space when resolving by name) cannot be resolved, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to create lists in that folder, and CONFLICT if the operation is refused due to parent state or invalid lifecycle transition (for example, creating under an archived/deleted folder/space per cache lifecycle rules).

folderId.description: Local folder node id (nodes.id) where the list will be created.

folderName.description: Folder name to resolve the folder when folderId is not provided.

spaceId.description: Local space node id (nodes.id) used to scope folderName resolution.

spaceName.description: Space name used to scope folderName resolution when spaceId is not provided.

archived.description: Whether the list should be created as archived.

overrideStatuses.description: Whether the list should override folder/space statuses.

tool_schemas.name: get_list
tool_schemas.description: Returns the list details for the specified listId or for a list resolved by listName, including cached metadata about the list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither listId nor listName is provided or if listId does not match the required pattern. Raises NOT_FOUND if the list cannot be resolved (including ambiguous/unscopeable name resolution), and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to view the resolved list.

listId.description: Local list node id (nodes.id) to retrieve.

listName.description: List name to resolve and retrieve (less reliable than listId).

tool_schemas.name: update_list
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing list’s properties (name/content/archive/overrideStatuses and/or the local cache lifecycle status) and returns the updated list record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither listId nor listName is provided, if no updatable fields are supplied, if status is not one of the allowed values, or if listId does not match the required pattern. Raises NOT_FOUND if the list cannot be resolved, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to modify the list, and CONFLICT if the requested change is an invalid lifecycle/state transition (for example, updating a deleted list or setting incompatible archive/status combinations).

listId.description: Local list node id (nodes.id) to update.

listName.description: List name to resolve and update (less reliable than listId).

status.description: Local list record status to set (mirrors cache lifecycle).

archived.description: Whether the list should be archived in ClickUp.

overrideStatuses.description: Whether the list should override parent statuses.

tool_schemas.name: delete_list
tool_schemas.description: Permanently deletes the specified list and its tasks and returns a deletion result for the list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither listId nor listName is provided or if listId does not match the required pattern. Raises NOT_FOUND if the list cannot be resolved for deletion, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to delete the list, and CONFLICT if deletion is refused due to list lifecycle/state (for example, already deleted or blocked by an invalid transition).

listId.description: Local list node id (preferred) to delete (nodes.id where node_type='list').

listName.description: List name to resolve and delete (requires an appropriate scope such as parent folder/space in the server's resolver).

tool_schemas.name: create_folder
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new folder in the specified space and returns the created folder record as cached locally, resolving the parent by spaceId or by spaceName. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is missing/empty, if neither spaceId nor spaceName is provided, or if spaceId does not match the required pattern/fields are otherwise invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the target space cannot be resolved, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to create folders in that space, and CONFLICT if folder creation is refused due to parent lifecycle/state (for example, attempting to create under an archived/deleted space per cache lifecycle rules).

spaceId.description: Local space node id (preferred) in which to create the folder (nodes.id where node_type='space').

spaceName.description: Space name to resolve (within a workspace) in which to create the folder.

override_statuses.description: Whether the folder should use its own statuses instead of inheriting from the space.

tool_schemas.name: get_folder
tool_schemas.description: Returns the folder details for folderId or resolves by folderName scoped by spaceId/spaceName, including cached metadata about the folder. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if folderId is not provided and folderName is missing, if folderName is provided without spaceId/spaceName, or if provided ids do not match required patterns. Raises NOT_FOUND if the folder (or scoping space when resolving by name) cannot be resolved, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to view the resolved folder.

folderId.description: Local folder node id (preferred) to retrieve (nodes.id where node_type='folder').

folderName.description: Folder name to resolve and retrieve (requires spaceId or spaceName).

spaceId.description: Local space node id to scope folderName resolution (nodes.id where node_type='space').

spaceName.description: Space name to scope folderName resolution (within a workspace).

tool_schemas.name: update_folder
tool_schemas.description: Modify an existing folder's properties. Valid parameter combinations: 1. Use folderId alone (preferred) 2. Use folderName + (spaceId or spaceName) At least one update field (name or override_statuses) must be provided.

folderId.description: Local folder node id (preferred) to update (nodes.id where node_type='folder').

folderName.description: Folder name to resolve for update (requires spaceId or spaceName).

spaceId.description: Local space node id to scope folderName resolution (nodes.id where node_type='space').

spaceName.description: Space name to scope folderName resolution (within a workspace).

override_statuses.description: Set whether the folder overrides statuses from its space.

tool_schemas.name: delete_folder
tool_schemas.description: Permanently deletes a folder and everything under it (all lists and tasks), returning a confirmation of the deleted folder node; identify the target either by folderId, or by resolving folderName within a space via spaceId or spaceName. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if you provide neither folderId nor folderName, if folderName is provided without a space scope, or if any provided id fails the expected format. Raises NOT_FOUND when the folder (or the scoping space for name resolution) cannot be resolved, and raises FORBIDDEN when you lack permission to delete in the target space/folder.

folderId.description: Local folder node id (preferred and safest) to delete (nodes.id where node_type='folder').

folderName.description: Folder name to resolve and delete (requires spaceId or spaceName).

spaceId.description: Local space node id to scope folderName resolution (nodes.id where node_type='space').

spaceName.description: Space name to scope folderName resolution (within a workspace).

tool_schemas.name: get_me
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity and current authorization context for this ClickUp-connected MCP server, including the resolved ClickUp user/team identity when available, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Refuses requests with invalid or missing credentials.

clickupApiToken.description: ClickUp API token used to authenticate to the upstream ClickUp API; when provided, the server validates it and returns the associated identity and entitlements.

tool_schemas.name: get_bulk_job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns a single bulk job by bulkJobId within the scoped workspaceId, including its current status, result_summary, and timestamps. This endpoint is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are missing/invalid and NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist in the workspace.

workspaceId.description: Local workspace id (cu_wsp_...) that owns the bulk job.

bulkJobId.description: Local bulk job id (cu_bjk_...) to fetch.
